human_constraints: Recurring mandatory cost must remain USD 0.
Do not require Supabase for Prometeo to continue operating.
Do not ask the human to transport state, worker results, prompts or files when machine-readable durable state exists.
Do not create a parallel queue, scheduler, worker family, CURRENT, Work Graph or persistence authority.
V10 remains CURRENT_BASELINE; V11 remains CANDIDATE until its existing promotion gates pass.
No destructive DELETE, VACUUM, pruning or destructive migration against the failed PostgreSQL instance without recovered runtime plus read-only measurement first.

current_truth.supabase_runtime_truth: PostgreSQL still crash-loops on pg_wal/xlogtemp: No space left on device; pause/restore did not restore SQL connectivity.
current_truth.github_runtime_evidence: gh-pages live/claim-frontier.json already exposes PORTFOLIO_PIN_CREATE claims and states that atomic create remains authority.
current_truth.github_native_canary: GHNATIVE-C0-10 ARMED: 10 fixed page-audit slots, GitHub-only claims/returns/peer verification; Supabase forbidden.

target_shape: GitHub stores durable public work state, PIN claims/generations, RETURNs, verification receipts, Closure Packs and compact projections.
GitHub Actions compiles derived frontiers, statistics, Current Tree/Control projections and bounded compaction outputs.
Reads and polling are zero-write by default.
Worker heartbeat/progress writes are coalesced into semantic lease/checkpoint transitions rather than breath-by-breath telemetry.
Private prompts, transcripts, audio, attachment URLs/tokens, PII and private packets never cross into the public repository.
Supabase is not a runtime dependency for the candidate path; if recovered, it is treated as a legacy evidence/recovery source until explicitly revalidated.
existing_reuse: coordination/portfolio/derived/** for durable executable work descriptions
coordination/portfolio/pins/** with generation-fenced atomic claim files
coordination/portfolio/returns/** for worker returns and verified receipts
gh-pages/live/claim-frontier.json as compact public claim hint
CURRENT Work Graph / Universal Worker Cycle semantics
Design DNA preserve-first, baseline, fresh-agent and evidence requirements
Current Tree V2 as projection/index, never truth owner

phases.name: Continuity + candidate contract
phases.goal: Keep the latest human intent, architecture direction, evidence boundary and exact next reconstructible from Git alone.
phases.next: Use this Continuity Room as projection; refetch main before every material action.

phases.name: GitHub-native persistence adapter
phases.goal: Map CURRENT Work Graph/Worker Cycle mutations to existing GitHub PIN/RETURN/generation mechanisms without new scheduler authority.
phases.next: Validate with GHNATIVE-C0-10 before any production persistence pointer changes.

phases.name: Zero-write read path
phases.goal: Remove write-on-read/write-on-poll behavior and coalesce heartbeat/progress.
phases.next: Static audit then isolated reversible patches with regression receipts.

phases.name: GitHub-only canary
phases.goal: Ten fresh workers audit ten real pages using GitHub-only claim→RETURN→peer verification.
phases.next: Launch the identical GHNATIVE-C0-10 prompt exactly ten times; no slot numbering or routing.

phases.name: Projection + Page Change
phases.goal: Current Tree/V11/Page Change consume Git-derived state and truthful degraded/private boundaries.
phases.next: Preserve human review and private-packet postclaim boundary.

phases.name: Legacy recovery
phases.goal: Recover useful historical Supabase bytes only when a free safe route becomes available.
phases.next: Never block the GitHub-native candidate on this phase.

exact_next: Launch exactly 10 fresh /wc chats with the identical GHNATIVE-C0-10 prompt from /github-native-canary/.
Do not number or route slots; each worker creates its own fresh beacon and atomically claims one of ten fixed slots.
Observe /github-native-canary/ until claims/returns/verifications appear from main.
After the run, reconcile worker findings, especially CONTROL_V11, /w and /wc, then patch only evidence-backed gaps.
Require 10/10 claims + 10/10 returns + 0 Supabase + 0 target mutations + >=8 independent verifications before treating the candidate transport as canary PASS.
Only after PASS, integrate GitHub-native persistence behind CURRENT interfaces and then expand to a 50-page worker wave.
